'''''Star Wars Battlefront''''' is a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] from [[DICE]], a game developer owned by [[Electronic Arts]]. It is DICE's take on the format presented in the [[Star Wars Battlefront (series)|first two ''Battlefront'' games]], which were released in [[2004]] and [[2005]].
